Definition: to cut or carve (wood, stone or other material); by implication, to hew, split, square, quarry, engrave
BiblicalUsage: To hew is to cut stone or wood with force, and the word cuts both ways in Scripture. God tells His people to look to the rock from which they were hewn, yet they hewed out broken cisterns that hold no water, Wisdom hews out seven pillars for her house, and God hews the people by the prophets.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the same cutting can build or expose: Wisdom's hewn pillars stand, while broken cisterns show what men make when they cut away from God. I want to be hewn from the rock, not by my own hand.
